description: Defines the AddressList class for managing collections of IP endpoints and DNS aliases, including methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: Manages a list of IP endpoints and associated DNS aliases, with methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&)
methods.description: Creates an address list for a single IP endpoint.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&, std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Creates an address list for a single IP endpoint with DNS aliases.

methods.name: AddressList(std::vector<IPEndPoint>)
methods.description: Creates an address list from multiple IP endpoints.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddress
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from an IPAddress and port.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a list of IPAddresses and DNS aliases.

methods.name: CreateFromAddrinfo
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from addrinfo chain.

methods.name: CopyWithPort
methods.description: Returns a copy of AddressList with all endpoints set to a specific port.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName
methods.description: Sets the first DNS alias to the first IP address in the list.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Creates a value representation for logging.

methods.name: Deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate IP addresses while preserving order.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint list is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the endpoint vector.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an endpoint to the list.
